task.subject: fix(mcp): bridge _eid strip preserves CJK bytes (ensure_ascii=False, Task 4 review)

winning_diff:
--- a/ops/mcp_stdio_to_cloud.py
+++ b/ops/mcp_stdio_to_cloud.py
@@ -185,7 +185,8 @@ def _strip_eid_and_track(line, link: "_CloudLink") -> bytes:
     eid = msg.pop("_eid")
     try:
         link.note_high_eid(int(eid))
     except (TypeError, ValueError):
         pass

+    return json.dumps(msg, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
